caption: The video captures a high-angle view of a clear glass measuring cup resting on a white cloth printed with a teal leaf pattern, beneath a watermark in the upper right. Inside the cup, green matcha liquid holds floating powder clumps, surface bubbles, and a pale patch. A white-gloved hand grips a metal balloon whisk from the top, while a second gloved hand steadies the cup's handle at the right edge. The whisk sweeps in a continuous stirring motion through the bottom and center, folding the dry powder and pale patch into the liquid. Surface bubbles become incorporated and less distinct as the separated mixture thickens into a more homogeneous green paste, and a mound of partially mixed powder is worked into the surrounding liquid. The holding hand stays near the handle while the whisk moves through the cup.
